root_cause.text: In nci_close_device(), pending NCI data exchanges are not completed before closing, so the callback that releases a socket reference (e.g., rawsock_data_exchange_complete) is never invoked, causing a socket memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit calls to `nci_data_exchange_complete()` when `test_bit(NCI_DATA_EXCHANGE, &ndev->flags)` is true, with the commit message stating "In nci_close_device(), complete any pending data exchange before closing. The data exchange callback holds a socket reference." The leak backtrace shows a socket allocation (via `sk_prot_alloc`) that is never freed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Abort pending NFC data exchange with -ENODEV when closing the device to avoid incomplete operations.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional call to nci_data_exchange_complete with -ENODEV if the NCI_DATA_EXCHANGE flag is set during device close, before unlocking the mutex.
intent_record.how: This ensures that any ongoing data exchange is terminated with an error when the device is being closed, preventing potential hangs or use-after-free by completing the pending operation with a device-not-found error.

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure proper cleanup of data timer and abort any ongoing data exchange with error when closing NCI device.
intent_record.what: Added deletion of data_timer and, if a data exchange is in progress, completion with -ENODEV in nci_close_device.
intent_record.how: Calls timer_delete_sync for data_timer; checks NCI_DATA_EXCHANGE flag and calls nci_data_exchange_complete with NULL, cur_conn_id, and -ENODEV to abort the exchange.
